description: FULL BODY. A male Malaysian police officer in his late 30s. He is wearing a formal navy blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform with silver badges on the chest, a black leather belt, and polished black boots. He has a clean-shaven face and a neat, short haircut.

FULL BODY. A Malaysian woman in her early 50s. She is wearing a traditional modest Baju Kurung in a soft floral pattern with a matching solid-colored pastel tudung (hijab). She is wearing simple black flat shoes.

FULL BODY. A featureless, anonymous human silhouette made of digital static and glowing blue binary code. The figure has no facial features and is wearing a translucent, glowing business suit that flickers with electronic interference.
